results_due: late January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (28 Oct to 6 Nov)
reasoning: Q2 revenue was a record ₹1,536 Cr (+18% on Q1, +35% on Q2 FY26). Order book is ₹25,100 Cr with ₹3,600 Cr of wins in Q2, BEV revenue grew 40% on the quarter and traction motors about 50%. We assume a smaller step of 7% to ₹1,640 Cr (+37% on Q3 FY26's ₹1,200 Cr).
Margin: 23.0% in Q2 and 23.1% in H1, at the bottom of the 23-25% range management says it will keep; motor mix is rising and freight and steel costs are high, so we use 23%.
PAT margin about 14.4%, as in Q2; lower depreciation helped it.
risks: Further mix shift to lower-margin motors takes margin below 23%
Input and freight inflation from the West Asia conflict
US EV programme volumes stay flat
Denso JV carve-out accounting in the quarter
